instructions: Blanch the spinach and blend it with the water.
Fry cumin, chopped onion, ginger and garlic in oil until softened.
Stir in the spinach and simmer briefly.
Fold in paneer cubes, cream and salt and heat through.
recipes.title: Palak Paneer

instructions: Simmer chopped tomatoes, cashews and ginger in water until soft, then blend.
Cook the puree in butter until thick.
Stir in garam masala, crushed fenugreek leaves, cream and salt.
Add the cubed paneer and simmer gently.
recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala

instructions: Toast the cumin in oil and brown the chopped onion.
Add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, ground coriander and salt and cook to a paste.
Add chickpeas and water and simmer until the sauce coats the chickpeas.
Mash a spoonful of chickpeas into the sauce and stir in garam masala.
recipes.title: Chana Masala

instructions: Brown chopped onion in oil, then add ginger and garlic.
Cook down the tomatoes with cumin and salt.
Simmer the cooked kidney beans in the tomato mixture with water until creamy.
Finish with garam masala.
recipes.title: Rajma Masala

instructions: Rinse the pigeon peas and simmer with water, turmeric and chopped tomato until tender.
Whisk the cooked dal and season with salt.
Heat ghee separately and fry cumin, sliced garlic and dried chilies until fragrant.
Pour the tempering over the hot dal.
recipes.title: Dal Tadka

ingredients.original_phrase: 2 cups of cooked whole black gram

instructions: Cook ginger, garlic and chili in butter, then reduce the tomato puree in the same pot.
Add the cooked beans, water and salt and simmer until creamy, stirring often.
Mash a few beans against the pot and finish with cream.
recipes.title: Dal Makhani

instructions: Fry cumin and sliced onion in oil until the onion softens.
Stir in ginger, turmeric, coriander and salt.
Add diced potato and cauliflower florets and cook covered over low heat until tender, stirring occasionally.
recipes.title: Aloo Gobi

instructions: Soften chopped onion and ginger in oil.
Add tomatoes, cumin and turmeric and cook into a sauce.
Simmer diced potatoes in the sauce with water and salt until nearly tender.
Add peas and finish cooking uncovered.
recipes.title: Aloo Matar

instructions: Roast the eggplant at 220 C until it collapses and the flesh is tender.
Peel away the skin and mash the flesh.
Fry chopped onion, garlic and green chili in oil and cook in the tomatoes until soft.
Mix in the eggplant and salt, then finish with cilantro.
recipes.title: Baingan Bharta

instructions: Dry and slice the okra, then saute it in half the oil until lightly browned.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil and cook the tomato with coriander and turmeric.
Return the okra and season with salt and dried mango powder.
recipes.title: Bhindi Masala

instructions: Whisk yogurt with one-quarter cup of flour, turmeric, salt and most of the water.
Fry cumin in a little oil, pour in the yogurt mixture and stir while bringing it to a simmer.
Mix sliced onion with the remaining flour and just enough remaining water to form a thick batter.
Shallow-fry spoonfuls of batter until cooked through and add them to the simmering kadhi.
recipes.title: Kadhi Pakora

instructions: Boil and mash the potatoes, then combine with grated paneer, cornstarch and a little salt.
Shape into small balls and shallow-fry until golden.
Simmer tomatoes and cashews in water, blend, then reduce the puree with garam masala and salt.
Finish the gravy with cream and add the koftas just before serving.
recipes.title: Malai Kofta

instructions: Fry chopped onion and ginger in oil until golden.
Add tomatoes, coriander and salt and cook until thick.
Simmer peas in the sauce with water until tender.
Add paneer cubes and garam masala and cook briefly.
recipes.title: Matar Paneer

instructions: Parboil and peel the potatoes, then brown them in oil.
Fry cumin in the same pan and lower the heat.
Whisk yogurt with water, chili, fennel, ginger and salt and add it while stirring.
Return the potatoes and simmer gently until tender.
recipes.title: Dum Aloo

instructions: Coat the chicken in yogurt, half the ginger, some garlic, garam masala and salt.
Sear the chicken in some butter and set it aside.
Cook the remaining ginger and garlic in butter and reduce the tomato puree with crushed fenugreek leaves.
Return the chicken and simmer to 74 C at the center, then stir in cream.
recipes.title: Butter Chicken

instructions: Brown the sliced onions in oil and blend them with the cashews and half the water.
Fry cardamom, ginger and garlic in the same pan, then brown the chicken.
Stir in the onion paste, whisked yogurt, remaining water and salt.
Simmer gently until the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
recipes.title: Chicken Korma

instructions: Dry-toast coconut, fennel, peppercorns and dried chili, then blend with a splash of the measured water.
Fry the curry leaves and chopped onion in oil, then cook down the tomatoes.
Add chicken, spice paste, salt and the remaining water.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
recipes.title: Chicken Chettinad

instructions: Soften chopped onion and garlic in oil, then add the ground spices.
Stir in coconut milk, tamarind and salt and bring to a gentle simmer.
Lower the fish pieces into the sauce and poach until the center reaches 63 C.
recipes.title: Goan Fish Curry

instructions: Hard-boil the eggs and peel them.
Fry curry leaves and sliced onions in coconut oil until deep golden.
Add ginger, garlic, spices, tomatoes and salt and cook to a thick masala.
Halve the eggs and coat them in the masala.
recipes.title: Kerala Egg Roast

instructions: Simmer the pigeon peas in half the water until soft, then mash them.
Cook carrot, eggplant and tomato in the remaining water with sambar powder, tamarind and salt.
Stir the dal into the cooked vegetables and simmer.
Fry mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and add the tempering.
recipes.title: Sambar

instructions: Simmer crushed tomatoes, tamarind, garlic, rasam powder and salt in water until fragrant.
Heat ghee in a small pan and fry mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering into the rasam and scatter cilantro over it.
recipes.title: Tomato Rasam

instructions: Soften diced onion and carrot in oil and stir in curry powder.
Add chopped apple, lentils and stock and simmer until the lentils break down.
Blend the soup, stir in coconut milk and finish with lemon juice.
recipes.title: Mulligatawny Soup

instructions: Soften onion and ginger in olive oil.
Add chopped carrots and stock and simmer until the carrots are tender.
Blend until smooth and swirl yogurt into each bowl.
recipes.title: Carrot Ginger Soup

instructions: Stir-fry chopped garlic, ginger, scallion whites, cabbage, carrot and green beans in oil.
Add stock, soy sauce and vinegar and simmer until the vegetables are just tender.
Whisk cornstarch with water and stir it into the simmering soup to thicken.
Top with scallion greens and crispy noodles.
recipes.title: Vegetable Manchow Soup

instructions: Simmer chopped potato, cauliflower and peas in the water until soft, then mash.
Cook onion, bell pepper, tomatoes and masala in two tablespoons of butter.
Add the mashed vegetables and salt and stir until thick.
Toast the split pav in the remaining butter and serve with lemon.
recipes.title: Pav Bhaji

instructions: Rinse and drain the rice.
Fry cumin, bay leaf and onion in ghee, then stir in diced carrot and peas.
Add rice, water and salt and cook covered on low until the water is absorbed.
Rest covered briefly before fluffing.
recipes.title: Vegetable Pulao

instructions: Rinse the flattened rice in a sieve and let it soften while draining.
Toast the peanuts in oil and set aside.
Fry mustard seeds and curry leaves, then cook diced potato and onion until tender.
Fold in the softened poha, turmeric and salt. Finish with lemon juice and peanuts.
recipes.title: Poha

instructions: Dry-roast the semolina until fragrant and set it aside.
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and ginger in ghee.
Add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina while stirring, then cover and cook over low heat until fluffy.
recipes.title: Rava Upma

instructions: Rinse the rice and mung beans together.
Toast cumin in ghee, then stir in turmeric and the drained rice and dal.
Add water and salt and simmer covered until both grains are soft.
recipes.title: Moong Dal Khichdi

instructions: Knead the flour with enough water and a pinch of salt to make a pliable dough.
Boil, peel and mash the potatoes with chopped chili, cilantro, cumin and salt.
Enclose a scoop of potato in each dough ball and roll it flat.
Cook the parathas on a hot skillet with ghee until browned on both sides.
recipes.title: Aloo Paratha

instructions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess liquid.
Whisk the yogurt until smooth and fold in cucumber, cumin, mint and salt.
Chill before serving.
recipes.title: Cucumber Raita

instructions: Whisk chickpea flour, water, turmeric and salt to a pourable batter.
Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
Spread thin rounds of batter on an oiled skillet and cook both sides until browned.
recipes.title: Besan Chilla

instructions: Rinse the rice and simmer it in milk with crushed cardamom, stirring regularly.
When the rice is very soft and the milk thickens, stir in sugar until dissolved.
Serve warm or chilled with sliced almonds.
recipes.title: Kheer

instructions: Fry green curry paste in oil until fragrant and stir in coconut milk.
Add sliced chicken and eggplant and simmer until tender and the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar and fold in Thai basil.
recipes.title: Thai Green Chicken Curry

instructions: Brown tofu cubes in oil and lift them out.
Fry the red curry paste briefly in the pan and add coconut milk.
Simmer sliced bell pepper and green beans in the sauce until tender.
Return the tofu and finish with soy sauce and lime juice.
recipes.title: Thai Red Tofu Curry

instructions: Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk and add the beef.
Add the rest of the milk and water and simmer covered until the beef is nearly tender.
Add potato and onion and continue simmering until soft.
Season with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar and stir in peanuts.
recipes.title: Massaman Beef Curry

instructions: Brown chopped onion and chicken in oil.
Add sliced carrot, diced potato and water and simmer until tender and the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
Turn off the heat and dissolve the curry roux into the broth.
Simmer briefly until thickened.
recipes.title: Japanese Chicken Curry

instructions: Saute sliced onion and carrot in a little oil, add water and simmer until soft.
Dissolve the roux off the heat, then briefly simmer the sauce until thick.
Flatten the chicken and dredge it in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry until crisp and 74 C at the center, then slice and serve with the curry sauce.
recipes.title: Japanese Katsu Curry

instructions: Season the chicken with curry powder, garlic and salt.
Heat oil and brown the chicken with chopped onion and scallions.
Add thyme, diced potato and water and simmer until tender and the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
recipes.title: Jamaican Curry Chicken

instructions: Brown onions in oil with the cinnamon stick and curry powder.
Stir in the chicken and tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes soften.
Add potatoes, apricots, salt and water and simmer until the potatoes are tender and the chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
recipes.title: Cape Malay Chicken Curry

instructions: Rinse the lentils and simmer in water with sliced onion and turmeric until soft.
Add coconut milk and salt and simmer gently until creamy.
Fry mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil and pour over the dhal.
recipes.title: Sri Lankan Dhal Curry

instructions: Cook sliced onions in butter over medium-low heat until deeply golden, stirring often.
Add stock, thyme and pepper and simmer to combine the flavors.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with baguette and grated Gruyere, then broil until bubbling.
recipes.title: French Onion Soup

instructions: Soften chopped onion, carrot and celery in olive oil.
Add zucchini, tomatoes and stock and simmer until the vegetables soften.
Add beans and pasta and simmer until the pasta is tender.
Finish with grated Parmesan.
recipes.title: Minestrone

instructions: Roughly chop the vegetables and blend with garlic and vinegar.
Blend in olive oil and salt until smooth.
Chill thoroughly before serving.
recipes.title: Gazpacho

instructions: Warm the dashi and rehydrate the wakame separately.
Add cubed tofu and drained wakame to the broth and heat gently.
Take the pot off the heat and dissolve the miso in a ladleful of broth before stirring it back.
Top with sliced scallions.
recipes.title: Miso Soup

instructions: Simmer bruised lemongrass, sliced galangal and lime leaves in water to make a fragrant broth.
Add mushrooms and chopped chili and simmer until tender.
Poach the shrimp in the broth until opaque throughout.
Remove the tough aromatics before serving and season with fish sauce and lime juice.
recipes.title: Tom Yum Goong

instructions: Simmer galangal, bruised lemongrass and lime leaves in the stock.
Add coconut milk, sliced chicken and mushrooms and simmer gently until chicken reaches 74 C at the center.
Remove the tough aromatics before serving and add fish sauce and lime juice.
recipes.title: Tom Kha Gai

instructions: Char the cut onion and ginger and add them to water with star anise and chicken legs.
Simmer until the chicken reaches 74 C, then remove the meat and strain the broth.
Cook the rice noodles separately and divide them into bowls with shredded chicken.
Season the broth with fish sauce and ladle over the noodles. Serve with scallions and lime.
recipes.title: Chicken Pho

instructions: Simmer rice in the stock until tender, then add shredded cooked chicken.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice and gradually whisk in some hot broth.
Stir the tempered mixture into the pot and heat gently to 71 C without boiling.
Finish with black pepper.
recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup

instructions: Soften onion and celery in butter and stir in flour.
Whisk in clam juice and milk and add diced potato.
Simmer gently until the potatoes are tender.
Add drained clams and pepper and heat through.
recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder

instructions: Soften diced onion in butter, stir in flour, then gradually whisk in stock and milk.
Add broccoli florets and grated carrot and simmer until tender.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in grated cheddar until smooth.
recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup

instructions: Soften chopped onion and celery in oil and stir in ginger and cinnamon.
Add tomatoes, lentils and stock and simmer until the lentils soften.
Stir in the cooked chickpeas and heat through.
Finish with chopped cilantro.
recipes.title: Moroccan Harira

instructions: Cut tortillas into strips, toss with half the oil and bake at 200 C until crisp.
Soften onion and garlic in the remaining oil, then blend with tomatoes and a soaked, deseeded ancho chili.
Simmer the tomato mixture with the stock until flavorful.
Top the bowls with tortilla strips, avocado and lime.
recipes.title: Mexican Tortilla Soup

instructions: Soften chopped onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and stock and simmer until the flavors combine.
Blend with basil and black pepper until smooth.
recipes.title: Italian Tomato Basil Soup

instructions: Cook sliced pork belly and chopped kimchi in sesame oil until fragrant.

recipes.title: Kimchi Jjigae

instructions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the liquid.
Stir into the yogurt with grated garlic, dill, oil, lemon and salt.

recipes.title: Greek Tzatziki

Toss in spaghetti and a splash of reserved water until glossy.
Finish with chopped parsley.
recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio

instructions: Preheat a baking tray in the oven at 245 C.
Stretch the dough and top with tomato puree seasoned with salt and torn mozzarella.
Bake on the hot tray until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
Finish with basil and olive oil.
recipes.title: Margherita Pizza

instructions: Blend tahini, lemon and garlic until smooth.
Add chickpeas and salt and blend, adding water gradually until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
recipes.title: Hummus

instructions: Cook diced onion and bell pepper in oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, tomatoes and salt and simmer until thick.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook gently until the whites and yolks are set.
recipes.title: Shakshuka

instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fold in finely chopped onion, jalapeno and cilantro.
Serve immediately.
recipes.title: Guacamole

instructions: Scramble the eggs in a little oil and lift them out.
Stir-fry finely diced carrot, peas and scallion whites in the remaining oil.
Add chilled cooked rice and stir-fry until steaming hot, breaking up clumps.
Stir in soy sauce, eggs and scallion greens.
recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Rice

instructions: Brown the ground pork in oil, then stir in doubanjiang, garlic and ginger.
Add stock and cubed tofu and simmer until the pork reaches 71 C.
Whisk cornstarch with water and stir it into the sauce to thicken.
Finish with Sichuan pepper and scallions.
recipes.title: Mapo Tofu

instructions: Cook thinly sliced potatoes and onion gently in oil until tender, then drain.
Fold the warm vegetables and salt into beaten eggs.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over low heat until nearly set, then flip with a plate.
Cook the second side until the eggs are set.
recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla

instructions: Soak the fine bulgur in water until tender, then drain well.
Finely chop parsley, mint, tomatoes and scallions.
Toss with the bulgur, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
recipes.title: Tabbouleh

instructions: Soak the rice in water, drain it and steam until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar and salt and pour most over the hot rice.
Rest until absorbed, then serve with sliced mango and the remaining coconut sauce.
recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice

instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then peel and mash them coarsely.
Fry mustard seeds and curry leaves in half the oil, soften the sliced onion and stir in potatoes, turmeric and salt.
Spread a ladle of dosa batter thinly on a hot griddle and drizzle with a little remaining oil.
When the underside is crisp, add some potato filling, fold and repeat with the remaining batter.
recipes.title: Masala Dosa

instructions: Rinse the rice and boil in salted water until nearly tender, then drain.
Fry sliced onions in ghee until golden and reserve half for layering.
Add cauliflower, carrot, peas, yogurt, masala and salt to the pan and cook until the vegetables are nearly tender.
Layer rice, vegetables, mint and reserved onion in a covered pot and steam over low heat until the rice is tender.
recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani

instructions: Gently fry chopped garlic and ginger in oil.
Add finely chopped carrot and cabbage and stir briefly.
Pour in stock and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Turn off the heat and stir in lemon juice, cilantro and pepper.
recipes.title: Lemon Coriander Soup

instructions: Blend half the corn with some stock.
Simmer the puree, remaining corn and finely diced carrot in the rest of the stock.
Whisk cornstarch with water and stir it into the soup until slightly thickened.
Finish with scallions and white pepper.
recipes.title: Sweet Corn Soup

instructions: Toss pumpkin chunks in half the oil and roast at 200 C until tender.
Soften chopped onion and garlic in the remaining oil.
Simmer the pumpkin and stock with the aromatics, then blend until smooth.
Finish with cream and pepper.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup

instructions: Simmer stock with soy sauce, mirin and ginger, then remove the ginger.

Divide noodles between bowls and pour in the hot broth.
Top with halved eggs, scallions and strips of nori.
recipes.title: Shoyu Ramen

instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a saucepan. Stir in onion, ginger, garlic, ground cumin, and ground coriander and cook gently until fragrant.

Add cooked black chickpea toward the end and simmer gently until cooked and hot throughout.

recipes.title: Kerala Chicken Ishtu

recipes.title: Kerala Egg and Coconut Curry
